hints: Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.

"Get top chunks matching query" (vectorStorePinecone.load): The original used a Pinecone index with a separate embeddings node; here the default vector store is a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (search records by text), so Pinecone embeds the text itself.

"Get top chunks matching query": create a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (for example llama-text-embed-v2, field map text=text) and set pineconeIndexHost; the store uses the namespace "{{pineconeNamespace}}".
"Add to Pinecone vector store" folded a document (documentDefaultDataLoader); retrieved text is expected on the upstream payload as context/documents.

"Add to Pinecone vector store" (vectorStorePinecone.insert): The original used a Pinecone index with a separate embeddings node; here the default vector store is a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (upsert records), so Pinecone embeds the text itself.

"Add to Pinecone vector store": create a Pinecone index with integrated embedding (for example llama-text-embed-v2, field map text=text) and set pineconeIndexHost; the store uses the namespace "{{pineconeNamespace}}".
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect pinecone: `cdecli credential create -n "pinecone" -p pinecone --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
